name: Finite Element Analysis
summary: The finite element method for structural, thermal and dynamic analysis, from stiffness matrices to responsible use of commercial codes.

topics.name: Overview of FEA and the direct stiffness method
Spring, bar and truss elements; assembly and boundary conditions
Weak forms, variational principles and the Galerkin method
Shape functions and the isoparametric formulation
2D elements for plane stress, plane strain and axisymmetry
Meshing, element quality, convergence and error estimation
Nonlinear FEA: geometric nonlinearity, plasticity, hyperelasticity and contact
Explicit dynamics, impact and crash simulation
Verification, validation and good practice with commercial codes (ANSYS, Abaqus)
